components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled blue action used for posting, sign-in, and saves.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--bork-accent, #167ef3); color:#fff; font:700 14px/20px ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--bork-accent-hover, #3596ff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bork-focus, #75b8ff); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered pill for retries, theme changes, and source links.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid var(--bork-border, #21384b); border-radius:9999px; background:transparent; color:var(--bork-text, #e8f2fa); font:600 14px/20px ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--bork-surface-hover, #102438); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bork-focus, #75b8ff); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:var(--bork-surface-raised, #0c1c2d); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The shared email and profile field with a raised tonal fill.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-email">Email address</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--bork-text, #e8f2fa); font:700 14px/20px ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-input { width:100%; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid var(--bork-border, #21384b); border-radius:12px; outline:none; background:var(--bork-surface-raised, #0c1c2d); color:var(--bork-text, #e8f2fa); font:400 16px/24px ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--bork-text-muted, #9cb1c2); opacity:1; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--bork-accent, #167ef3); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bork-focus, #75b8ff); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-input:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.62; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: A compact left-rail destination with a blue active icon.
components.html: Feed
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display:flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:12px; color:var(--bork-text-muted, #9cb1c2); text-decoration:none; font:600 15px/20px ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition:color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link svg { width:20px; height:20px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color:var(--bork-text, #e8f2fa); background:var(--bork-surface-hover, #102438); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] svg { color:var(--bork-accent, #167ef3); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bork-focus, #75b8ff); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Post Row
components.description: A border-separated public bork in the continuous reading lane.
components.html:
CS

Good code. Better dogs.
components.css: .ds-post-row { display:flex; gap:12px; padding:20px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--bork-border, #21384b); background:transparent; color:var(--bork-text, #e8f2fa); font-family:ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-post-row:hover { background:var(--bork-surface-hover, #102438); } .ds-post-avatar { display:flex; width:48px; height:48px; flex:0 0 48px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bork-accent, #167ef3) 48%, var(--bork-border, #21384b)); border-radius:9999px; background:var(--bork-surface-raised, #0c1c2d); color:var(--bork-text-muted, #9cb1c2); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; } .ds-post-meta { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:baseline; color:var(--bork-text-muted, #9cb1c2); font-size:14px; line-height:20px; } .ds-post-meta strong { color:var(--bork-text, #e8f2fa); } .ds-post-row p { max-width:70ch; margin:8px 0 0; white-space:pre-wrap; font-size:17px; line-height:28px; } @media (min-width:768px) { .ds-post-row { padding-right:24px; padding-left:24px; } }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The raised feed composer ending in the only filled action.
components.html: Short posts for good dogs and their people.
components.css: .ds-composer { padding:20px 16px; background:var(--bork-surface-raised, #0c1c2d); color:var(--bork-text, #e8f2fa); font-family:ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-sr-only { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; padding:0; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; border:0; } .ds-composer textarea { width:100%; min-height:92px; resize:none; padding:4px 0; border:0; outline:none; background:transparent; color:var(--bork-text, #e8f2fa); caret-color:var(--bork-accent, #167ef3); font:400 18px/28px ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder, .ds-composer-footer span { color:var(--bork-text-muted, #9cb1c2); } .ds-composer textarea:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bork-focus, #75b8ff); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-composer-footer { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-top:12px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--bork-border, #21384b); font-size:12px; line-height:16px; } .ds-composer button { display:inline-flex; min-width:80px; min-height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--bork-accent, #167ef3); color:#fff; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; } .ds-composer button:hover { background:var(--bork-accent-hover, #3596ff); } .ds-composer button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bork-focus, #75b8ff); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Mobile Navigation
components.description: The three-destination bottom bar shown below 768px.
components.html: FeedSign inSettings
components.css: .ds-mobile-nav { display:grid; height:64px; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); border-top:1px solid var(--bork-border, #21384b); background:var(--bork-surface, #071525); color:var(--bork-text, #e8f2fa); font-family:ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-mobile-nav a { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:4px; color:var(--bork-text-muted, #9cb1c2); text-decoration:none; font-size:12px; line-height:16px; font-weight:600; } .ds-mobile-nav svg { width:20px; height:20px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-mobile-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color:var(--bork-text, #e8f2fa); background:var(--bork-surface-hover, #102438); } .ds-mobile-nav a[aria-current="page"] svg { color:var(--bork-accent, #167ef3); } .ds-mobile-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bork-focus, #75b8ff); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
Night Rails is a familiar social feed drawn as one continuous midnight workspace. A compact navigation rail, a broad reading lane, and a concise project rail share the same canvas. Cool hairlines and small tonal shifts separate regions without turning the page into a stack of cards.

Bork's personality lives in the dog mark, the word "bork," friendly copy, circular portraits, and the animated loading dog. Controls stay recognizable. The result should read first as a finished social product, then as a dog-first project with a point of view.
keyCharacteristics: Dark mode is primary, with a complete light role mapping.
Desktop uses one continuous three-lane shell; mobile replaces both rails with a header and bottom navigation.
One filled blue action carries the strongest emphasis.
Tonal surfaces and cool hairlines provide depth without authored shadows.
Rounded controls and circular avatars soften an otherwise compact layout.

rules.name: The One Blue Action Rule
rules.body: Blue may identify state, focus, and links, but only the primary action receives a filled saturated treatment.

rules.name: The Role-Pair Rule
rules.body: Every dark semantic role has a light counterpart. Theme changes swap role values, not component structure.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use the rounded system stack for every role. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, line height, and tracking, not a second typeface.

rules.name: The Whole-Rail Collapse Rule
rules.body: Do not squeeze desktop rails into narrow sidebars. Remove them as complete units and supply the mobile header and bottom navigation.

rules.name: The Reading-Lane Rule
rules.body: Keep composer, state messages, and posts in the same 720px lane, separated by hairlines rather than floating cards.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layering and cool hairlines at rest. Do not add shadows to feed rows, rails, fields, or cards.

rules.name: The Compact-Round Rule
rules.body: Rounded shapes soften controls without turning content regions into bubbles. Feed rows and page sections remain square and continuous.

dos: Do keep dark mode as the primary presentation and maintain every light-mode role.
Do reserve the filled blue pill for the strongest action in a region.
Do use hairlines and tonal surfaces to separate rails, composer, posts, forms, and empty states.
Do keep dog personality in the mark, loading asset, portraits, vocabulary, and concise copy.
Do preserve the global 2px focus-visible outline and reduced-motion fallback.
Do give every mobile `aria-current="page"` link primary text, a hover-surface fill, and a blue icon.
donts: Don't add gradients. Every shipped surface is a solid semantic color.
Don't add glass effects, blur, translucent panels, or glow.
Don't wrap feed rows or rail sections in floating rounded cards.
Don't introduce a second saturated action color or use warning red as decoration.
Don't add novelty controls or dog-themed chrome such as paw-shaped buttons.
Don't animate routine content beyond the short first-row settle and ordinary state transitions.
Don't present a query failure as an empty or not-found state.
